title: Restricted Fourier weight bound
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be a Boolean-valued function, let $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and let $\mathcal A$ be any family of subsets of $J$. For each $S\subseteq J$, sum the squared Fourier coefficients of $f$ over all frequencies whose intersection with $J$ is $S$; the sum of these restricted weights over $S\in\mathcal A$ is at most $1$.
hypotheses_covered: target is a Boolean function on the n-dimensional sign cube
J is a finite set of coordinates
𝒜 is a finite family of subsets of J
